Original · Unique Research · 2025-11-21

Historical edition note: This is a full English rendition of Unique Research’s article published on November 21, 2025. The figures, selection judgments, and references to “today,” “this year,” and the future reflect the original 2025 publication, not a new selection or current assessment.

In front of countless screens late at night, people are using a single computer, line after line of code, and prompt after prompt to build their own little universes:

Some turn AI into a camera, creating a new generation of short-form dramas and visual storytelling;

Some turn AI into a paintbrush, producing visual art and music unlike anything seen before;

And some turn AI into a colleague, running a one-person company in the truest sense.

They are the AI Creators of this era.

Today, we are officially unveiling the inaugural 2025 AI Creators 100 annual list, introducing 100 creators who are reshaping how work is made, how businesses are built, and how far individuals can go.

01 Why Create an AI Creators 100 List?

Over the past year, one thing has become increasingly clear to us:

AI is not merely an upgrade to our tools; it is rewriting the structure of individual capability.

Some use multimodal models to experiment with film, music, and storytelling;

Some use intelligent Agents to put complex workflows on autopilot;

Some use AIGC tools to build IP, brands, and enduring content assets;

And some have already used AI to complete the entire loop from product creation to monetization.

That is why, beginning in 2025, Unique Research officially launched the annual AI Creators 100 selection.

We aim to systematically find, document, and honor people who use AI deeply rather than merely dabbling in it;

People who have genuinely created something new in creativity, products, or business;

People who represent the upper bounds of what individuals and small teams may be able to achieve over the next several years.

This list is not a one-off collection of popular names. It is a long-term annual framework for observing the field.

02 Who Are They? Creative Talent Across Four Quadrants

To present the AI creator ecosystem more completely, we divided this year's honorees into four quadrants, each representing a characteristic path:

AI Art Pioneers (Creator): Creators working in film, music, narrative, visual art, and related fields who are opening new frontiers in AI aesthetics and imagination.

Technology and Tool Geeks (Builder): Independent developers, open-source contributors, and prompt engineers who provide the infrastructure and arsenal for creators.

Leaders of Ideas and Advocacy (Influencer): Bloggers, educators, and community organizers who translate complex AI knowledge for broader audiences and genuinely advance understanding.

Business and Model Explorers (Founder): Builders who can use extremely small teams to establish clear business models and profitable closed loops, representing the one-person company of the AI era.

The 100 honorees work across short-form drama, music, visual art, digital humans, intelligent Agents, writing, code generation, and many other fields. You will see established experts alongside emerging faces; prominent creators with substantial reach alongside hidden standouts who have not yet broken into the mainstream but show exceptional potential.

03 How Were They Selected? An Evaluation Model Designed for Creators

To avoid the crude approach of judging people solely by follower counts, we designed a four-dimensional framework specifically for AI creators: the CPIS model.

C – Creativity: Does the work have a distinctive style? Has AI genuinely enabled forms of expression that would not have existed before?

P – Product: Has the creator turned a work, tool, or service into a product? Does it have real users and real retention?

I – Impact: We look beyond raw metrics to consider reputation and recognition within professional communities and specialized circles.

S – Social Value & Potential: Has the creator contributed through open source, knowledge sharing, or industry practice? Does the work point toward future directions?

In the evaluation process, we considered platform and product data, recommendations from industry partners, input from the nomination committee, and our long-term observations. We also balanced representation across fields, aiming to make the list both representative and genuinely valuable as a discovery tool.

04 Who Nominated Them? A Vote of Confidence from Inside the Industry

The inaugural 2025 AI Creators 100 used an invitation-based nomination committee rather than simple open applications and public voting.

The nomination committee drew from two tracks:

One consisted of industry ecosystem partners, including AI technology companies, content platforms, and tool and service providers, which used data and frontline observations to recommend the strongest creators in their respective ecosystems.

The other consisted of influential figures in specialist circles, including super-individual creators, community organizers, representatives from academia and the creative industries, media professionals who have long followed the AI ecosystem, and investors. They brought more focused, professional perspectives to identifying people with a genuine spirit of exploration who may not yet have received broad public attention.

Our hope is that, from the moment these 100 names appear, they carry an underlying endorsement from people who truly understand the field.

Finally, we sincerely invite you to:

Share this list with people around you who are creating with AI;

Choose a few names on the poster that interest you most, follow them, and study the paths they have taken;

And recommend someone you believe should be part of the next AI Creators list.

Because in this era,

Everyone who treats creation seriously

Deserves to be seen.

The 2025 AI Creators 100 list is officially here!
